I wrote the solution in `main.wj`. It compiles with `wj build` and gives the expected output on both examples.

I ran it on both examples plus a blank line and `2023-02-29 2023-03-01`. The blank line was skipped and the Feb 29 date in a non-leap year printed `invalid`. I didn't test other edge cases such as extra whitespace or dates outside 1900–2100.

Any year that parses as four digits is accept
